XBRL GL 2015 COR+BUS offline bundle

The schema and linkbase files listed in manifest.json are unmodified files from
XBRL International, downloaded from the official URLs recorded with their SHA256.
Copyright XBRL International. Original copyright and legal references are retained.

This app assembles an offline taxonomy package. It does not claim that the app,
this package, an individual export, or its account classification is certified
by XBRL International or accepted by a filing authority.

Official recommendation and technical architecture:
https://specifications.xbrl.org/work-product-index-xbrl-gl-xbrl-gl-2015.html
https://www.xbrl.org/legal

The app's shared chart of accounts remains its own chart. Those codes are values
inside standard GL fields and are not IFRS/DART financial-reporting concepts.
